title: Hearty Herbal Egyptian Fish Papillote
description: A sour and shattering festive Egyptian dish featuring gorgonzola-dolce, this pescatarian-friendly recipe is perfect for special occasions, with a unique blend of herbs and spices that will leave your taste buds wanting more.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, parsley, and dill.
Place a tilapia fillet in the center of each papillote paper sheet.
Brush the lemon juice mixture evenly over both sides of the tilapia fillets.
Crumble gorgonzola-dolce cheese over the top of each tilapia fillet.
Fold the papillote paper over the fish, creating a tight seal.
Place the papillote packets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12 minutes or until the fish is cooked through and the papillote paper is puffed and golden brown.
